_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
4/11 5:58AM - Up and at ‘em Stratton! It's officially the beginning of the end as we kick off our final weekend of the season. We’ll be getting after it on 32 open trails, with 30 of which receiving fresh corduroy overnight. Make your way up on the Gondola, American Express, and Ursa Express all set to spin at 8:30AM. Please note wind and weather related delays are likely due to high summit winds, along with overnight precipitation and dropping temperatures leading to firmer surface conditions in areas. We’ve got plenty of music and good vibes on tap this weekend, with Gather Outdoors serving up a proper season sendoff, and it’s all going down now; You won’t want to miss it!

The park scene is still kickin’, with 6 features on Tyrolienne and the half pipe rockin’ on East Byrnes Side, so don’t miss your chance to rack up those spring laps!

Gather Outdoors kicks off today with two stages and a stacked lineup, bringing everything from live jam and bass to forward-thinking electronic and house. Programming runs from mid-afternoon into the night so hit the slopes before rolling straight into après sets and late-night energy. Last-minute tickets are still up for grabs, so lock yours in before they’re gone! Please note, there will be infrastructure going in and ongoing construction around the resort as we get everything in place. Thanks for your patience as we gear up for the big sendoff.

Time to do what we do best; Let’s weekend one last time! 

Safety Tip: Unmarked hazards exist; Ski and ride with caution.

Lock in next season’s fun with a 26/27 Ikon Pass, officially on sale now. Here’s the best part– when you buy next season’s pass, you can ride the rest of this season too! Be sure to check out the season pass page to lock it in.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability!

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.
